caption:
"The thing that matters most, and that you really should focus on, is not how much reach your post got. If you want to understand why a post got more or less reach, you should focus on your engagement rates." — Adam Mosseri, head of Instagram.

Reach is the output. The engagement rate is the input that produced it. Reading reach to understand your account is like reading the bank balance to understand the business.

He also told creators to compare connected reach — followers who saw it — against unconnected reach, which is everyone else. That split tells you whether you are feeding your own audience or actually finding new people.

Practically: a post with 2,000 reach and a 9% rate is a better post than one with 12,000 reach and a 1% rate. The first one is teaching the system what you are good at. The second one is a lottery ticket that already paid out.

Judge the post by the rate. Judge the account by the trend in the rate.

Source: Mosseri's guidance to creators on reading Instagram Insights, 2026.
